biotools.summary: SuperSurv is an R package that provides a unified framework for building, evaluating, and interpreting ensemble machine learning models for right-censored survival data. It implements techniques like stacking and integrates interpretability tools such as SHAP values and Restricted Mean Survival Time (RMST) contrasts.
